SRI VENKATESWARA UNIVERSITY :: TIRUPATI – 517502
(ANDHRA PRADESH) INDIA
(Notification No. 4/SVU/E. II (2)/ASSOC. PROF. & PROF. /Regular/2026, dated
15.05.2026)
Recruitment Notification for Associate Professor and Professors
positions for Regular vacancies
Applications in the prescribed format are invited online for the following cadres of
Regular Vacancies for various departments on direct recruitment basis.
Faculty Position OC SC-I SC-II SC-III ST BC EWS
A B C D E
Associate Professors 9 1 1 1 1 2 1 1 1 1 2
Professors 2 1 - - - - - - - - -
Total posts: 1. Associate Professors - 21
2. Professors - 03
The detailed information of the above posts relating to qualification, experience,
pay scales, reservation, link for submission of filled-in online application etc., can be
obtained from the University website: www.svuniversity.edu.in or
https://apuniversitiesrecruitment.apcfss.in
Receiving of the online applications will commence from 18.05.2026.
The last date for submission of online application is 08.06.2026 (by 5.00 pm IST).
The last date for the submission of hardcopy of application (already submitted online)
along with the self- attested relevant documents is 15.06.2026 (by 5.00 pm IST).
NOTE: The University reserves the right to fill or not to fill any of the post(s) without
giving any reason whatsoever.
